title: VSTEP B2 Mock Test 1
description: Bài thi thử VSTEP B2 - Đánh giá năng lực tiếng Anh trình độ B2

sections.name: Listening
sections.instructions: Bạn sẽ nghe các đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi. Mỗi đoạn sẽ được phát 2 lần.

questions.questionText: What is the main topic of the conversation?
questions.explanation: The conversation focuses on planning a vacation trip.

questions.questionText: Where does the man want to go?
questions.explanation: The man mentions wanting to go to the mountains for hiking.

sections.name: Reading
sections.instructions: Đọc các đoạn văn và trả lời câu hỏi.

questions.questionText: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: B) The impact of social media
questions.explanation: The passage discusses how social media has changed communication.

questions.questionText: Which of the following are mentioned as benefits? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: The passage mentions increased connectivity and faster information sharing as benefits.

sections.name: Writing
sections.instructions: Viết một bài luận về chủ đề được đưa ra. Tối thiểu 150 từ.

questions.questionText: Write an essay discussing the advantages and disadvantages of online learning. Minimum 150 words.
questions.explanation: Essay will be graded based on content, organization, vocabulary, and grammar.
